column1: # Pinned requests for the CSV import-rules wire, replayed byte-for-byte by
# name<TAB>uri. Every request is served over fixtures/rules/tree/main.journal,
# whose directory IS the scan root — so the whole fixture is that tree, and
# changing any file in it changes these bodies.
# These cannot live in fixtures/native/v1/requests.tsv: native_wire_golden.rs
# replays that manifest against fixtures/sample.journal, and its
# `every_pinned_request_fixes_its_own_dates` guard requires every URI to carry
# an `asOf=`/`end=`/`to=`. Rules responses have no dates in them at all, and
# weakening that guard to admit them would un-pin the report goldens' defence
# against a body that drifts at midnight.
